description.narrative: HCFC PHASE-OUT MANAGEMENT PLAN (STAGE I) The management plan for the elimination of HCFCs in Togo, favors the proposed strategy to shift from HCFCs to HFCs or Hydrocarbons. This strategy relies mainly on economic instruments and regulations, framed by additional measures to be effective, including yearly update inventories programs, institutional strengthening, information, education and awareness of the parties, strengthening of capacity of some major stakeholders such as refrigeration technicians, security and control forces, the imposition of digressive import quotas and various controls. The government of Togo is proposing to meet its compliance targets to reduce HCFC consumption by 35 per cent in 2020 through the following activities: Phase I (a) Sensitizing of the stakeholders on the progressive elimination strategy and the alternatives; (UNEP) (b) Training of the custom officers and other control agents; (UNEP) (c) Training of the refrigeration technicians on the management of HCFCs; (UNEP) (d) Providing equipment for the refrigeration centres; (UNIDO) (e) Implementation of an incentive financial programme; and ((UNIDO) (f) Coordination, Management, Monitoring and Evaluation. (UNIDO/UNEP) Phase II Implementation of elimination program of the remaining consumption of HCFCs
